persona.name: Budi Santoso
persona.summary: Budi is CTO of Jakarta Teknologi, a 150-person SaaS company providing logistics analytics. Company knowledge lives in Slack, email, Google Workspace, Jira, and a custom CRM — predominantly Indonesian with English engineering threads.
persona.situation: A billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres is planned next sprint, led by Budi. The Surabaya warehouse reports an inventory discrepancy on SKU-6310, and the team needs to decide whether a read replica is needed before the Postgres cutover.

scopes.label: db-migration
scopes.business_meaning: The billing database migration from MySQL to Postgres: planning, risk, and cutover timeline.

scopes.label: inventory-discrepancy
scopes.business_meaning: Surabaya warehouse inventory discrepancy on SKU-6310: short by 110 units, investigating scan error.

scopes.label: infra-planning
scopes.business_meaning: Infrastructure planning: read replicas, backup strategy, and monitoring setup.

messages.body: Keputusan: migrasikan basis data penagihan dari MySQL ke Postgres pada sprint berikutnya; penanggung jawab Budi, risiko gangguan layanan saat peralihan.
Budi mengonfirmasi rencana migrasi Postgres: Langkah 1 ekspor data MySQL, Langkah 2 jalankan cutover di jendela pemeliharaan, Langkah 3 verifikasi integritas data. Perkiraan downtime 2 jam.
Engineering note (English): 'The MySQL to Postgres migration script is ready. Budi wants a dry run in staging before production. The cutover window is Saturday 2-4 AM WIB.'
Gudang Surabaya melaporkan selisih stok: SKU-6310 kurang 110 unit dibandingkan sistem; sedang menyelidiki kesalahan pemindaian. Kepala gudang Pak Surya telah konfirmasi hitung fisik.
Penyebab: pemindai barcode model lama mungkin melewatkan beberapa scan. Tim IT telah memperbarui firmware pemindai dan menghitung ulang SKU-6310.
Tiket INFRA-7821: Siapkan replika baca Postgres di staging. Penanggung jawab: Budi. Status: Sedang dikerjakan. Estimasi selesai: Jumat.

recall_tests.intent: Find the database migration plan and owner.

synthesis.business_question: What is the database migration plan, who owns it, and what is the risk?

forget.rationale: The inventory discrepancy has been resolved after firmware update and recount; the records can be purged.
